title: Choctaw Cultural Center

services.name: Facilities Rental
services.desc: If you need space for an event or meeting, consider the Choctaw Cultural Center. Our facility is not only beautiful, but it is versatile as well. We have rooms of all sizes and capacities to suit your needs. We even have Kowi Chito Theater, which seats up to 200 people and has state-of-the-art audio and visual equipment. Facility rentals are available outside of regular business hours, too! For a closer look at our spaces, amenities, and rental details, view the guide below. The Choctaw Cultural Center is conveniently located off Highway 75 in Calera, Oklahoma. services.desc: Educators and staff can book tours for their students during operating hours. School groups are limited to 60 students per visit and must be booked in advance.
